bottleneck_diagnostics_matrix.primary_corridor: South Greenville County (Simpsonville, Mauldin, Fountain Inn)
bottleneck_diagnostics_matrix.root_cause: Residential parcel subdivision approvals outpace Greenville Water trunk-line capacity by +31.4% (Threshold: >25%).
bottleneck_diagnostics_matrix.evidence_metric: 118.0% Subdivision Pacing vs. 86.6% Pumping Head Headroom
bottleneck_diagnostics_matrix.mitigation_target: Enact Urban Growth Boundaries (UGB) and water impact fee restructuring.

bottleneck_diagnostics_matrix.primary_corridor: Inland Port Greer ➔ I-85 / SC-101 / Woodruff Road
bottleneck_diagnostics_matrix.root_cause: Intermodal rail container lifts (+18% YoY) conflict with SCDOT grade crossings, generating 48,200 annual truck-hours of arterial queuing.
bottleneck_diagnostics_matrix.mitigation_target: Grade-separated overpasses and dedicated heavy-truck staging spurs.

bottleneck_diagnostics_matrix.primary_corridor: I-85 Industrial Belt & Pelham / GSP Substation Cluster
bottleneck_diagnostics_matrix.root_cause: Advanced manufacturing electrification (BMW EV supplier expansion) during July/August 95°F+ heat peaks compresses reserve margin to 8.2%.
bottleneck_diagnostics_matrix.evidence_metric: Peak Load: 413.1 MW on 450 MW Substation Ceiling (91.8% Peak)
bottleneck_diagnostics_matrix.mitigation_target: Deploy 45 MW utility-scale BESS solar microgrid at GSP non-aero land.
